check_scope.interactive_recovery: Actual browser, worklet and controls; generated silence and mocked provider/SpeechSynthesis events. Demonstrates recovery state transitions, not recognition accuracy.
check_scope.public_site: Actual production page, typed counts, review controls, CSV/session download bytes and desktop/mobile layout.

changes: Previously merged fragmented-count recovery and Needs review tray are now deployed.
Read-back timeout/error cancels speech before holding the microphone path.
Spoken count summaries retain item, quantity, units, echo and uncertainty without reciting long UI instructions.
Actual browser request uses a single JSON keyterms array and the observed 160/400 ms development profile.
remaining: Real interactive human voice/retry behavior has not passed validation.
Existing synthetic demonstration and presentation are historical, not evidence of this release passing a human test.
authentication: Existing Netlify runtime variables retained; no user setup change. One-time deployment capability was encrypted for the authorized runner; not committed in plaintext.
